text:
Priya (Support): Hey team, having an enterprise customer (AcmeMedia, org_id: org_9b2f) reporting the token cost dashboard shows $0 / NaN for multiple days. They attached a CSV and screenshot. Repro steps below. Can someone triage? :eyes:

Jorge (Billing): Thanks — can you paste the org_id and an example timestamp?

Priya (Support): org_9b2f, reported window 2026-03-02 -> 2026-03-08. Example UI cell shows `NaN` for 'model_token_cost' and $0 for 'total_token_cost'. CSV attached: rows with usage_id, org_id, model, tokens, price_per_token=null

Marta (Analytics): Quick suspicion: pricing_lookup join may have returned NULL for that tenant after the pricing_lookup_v2 rollout last night. We saw a nonzero failure rate on the join key mapping in canaries.

deploy-bot: deploy/redwood-api @ 2026-03-15T22:13:04 UTC — release/pricing_lookup_v2 (sha: f1a2b3c)

Alex (Platform): Confirming — pricing_lookup_v2 changed the join from `tenant_id` -> `customer_id` and added a mapping table. If mapping rows are missing the LEFT JOIN will produce NULL price values. Can you run a quick query to check?

Nikhil (SRE): Query suggestion (run in analytics-prod):
```sql
SELECT u.org_id, p.price_per_token, COUNT(*) AS rows
FROM usage_token_events u
LEFT JOIN pricing_lookup p ON u.customer_id = p.customer_id
WHERE u.org_id = 'org_9b2f'
GROUP BY u.org_id, p.price_per_token;
```

Marta (Analytics): Ran that — result: `org_9b2f | NULL | 4123` and one row `org_9b2f | 0.0005 | 0` (no matched rows). So pricing_lookup has no mapping for their customer_id.

Jorge (Billing): That matches the CSV — price_per_token is NULL. Downstream agg treats NULL as 0 or NaN depending on pipeline stage, which explains mixed $0/NaN tiles.

Priya (Support): Customer is on Dedicated + migrated account last month — possible missing mapping during on-prem migration. They are upset. Need ETA for fix or mitigations.

Alex (Platform): Mitigation options: 1) hotfix: change aggregation to fallback to org_default_price table when pricing_lookup NULL (fast DB patch) 2) backfill pricing_lookup for affected customer_ids from import snapshot 3) rollback pricing_lookup_v2 if mapping logic is broken.

Jorge (Billing): I can run a targeted backfill for org_9b2f now if we can provide the canonical customer_id mapping. Priya, please confirm the customer's canonical customer_id (not org_id) from their migration ticket.

Priya (Support): Ticket shows customer_id: cust_0x7f4a. Forwarding migration ticket link. :email:

Marta (Analytics): I'll prepare a short SQL backfill using canonical snapshot table `customer_snapshot`:
```sql
INSERT INTO pricing_lookup (customer_id, price_per_token, updated_at)
SELECT cs.customer_id, cs.default_price, now()
FROM customer_snapshot cs
WHERE cs.customer_id = 'cust_0x7f4a'
ON CONFLICT (customer_id) DO UPDATE SET price_per_token = EXCLUDED.price_per_token, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at;
```

Nikhil (SRE): Before backfill we should run a quick smoke check to ensure no other orgs are affected:
```sql
SELECT DISTINCT u.org_id
FROM usage_token_events u
LEFT JOIN pricing_lookup p ON u.customer_id = p.customer_id
WHERE p.customer_id IS NULL
LIMIT 50;
```

Alex (Platform): Good call. If the list is small we can run backfills. If it's widespread we should rollback and investigate migration transform.

Jorge (Billing): I'll run the smoke check and post results in 10m. Assigning to myself for backfill if it's single-digit orgs.

Priya (Support): Customer-facing note: will update ACMEMedia with "we identified missing price mapping after a recent pricing lookup rollout; performing targeted backfill now; expect dashboard fixes within 30-60 minutes after backfill and an email when complete."

Marta (Analytics): smoke check result (ran at 2954001400): found 3 orgs with NULL pricing_lookup: org_9b2f, org_7c3d, org_1a9e.

Jorge (Billing): Backfill plan: run per-org INSERT from snapshot for the three customer_ids, then trigger the metrics rollup job `rollup.token_costs_daily` for the affected orgs for dates 2026-03-01 -> 2026-03-10. Steps: 1) run backfills 2) run rollup with `--orgs` flag 3) verify UI tile. Will execute now. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: job/rollup.token_costs_daily started (id: job_8823)

Jorge (Billing): Backfills done at 2954001600. Triggered rollup. I'll monitor logs and post results.

Marta (Analytics): After rollup, query shows price_per_token populated and dashboard aggregation returns non-null totals for the three orgs. Verified sample UI screenshot (Priya please confirm with customer).

Priya (Support): Sent screenshot to ACMEMedia; they confirmed numbers returned and tile is now populated. Customer asked for root cause writeup and permanent fix roadmap.

Alex (Platform): Root cause draft: pricing_lookup_v2 introduced a mapping-table change; a subset of migrated customers were missing entries in the mapping snapshot used during the rollout. Short-term backfill applied. Long-term: add CI check to ensure pricing_lookup has coverage for all active customer_ids before promoting rollout; add fallback to org_default_price in aggregation pipeline; improve canary query to surface missing mapping rate >0.1%.

Priya (Support): Thanks everyone. I'll send customer update and CC platform on the root cause. Closing this thread once postmortem doc is ready. :tada:
